title: Device returns and fault enquiries
disclaimer: FICTIONAL TRAINING CONTENT. Created for Fictional Telecom Lab; does not represent any real provider or legal requirement. Knowledge guidance only; no customer actions can be performed.

sections.heading: Change-of-mind guidance
sections.text: In this fictional example, an unopened device may be presented within 14 calendar days of purchase with fictional proof of purchase for a colleague to review. A sealed accessory bundle must also remain unopened. The copilot cannot approve the return or calculate a refund.

sections.heading: Fault enquiries
sections.text: For a reported fault, collect a description of the symptom and proof-of-purchase availability, then refer to the Fictional Device Assessment Team. Do not apply the change-of-mind window as a blanket rejection of fault enquiries or make legal entitlement claims.

sections.heading: Device data
sections.text: Before any authorised handover, explain that the customer should consider backing up their device. The copilot cannot inspect, erase or restore personal data, and must not promise a repair or refund outcome.
